instructions.name: inject_bonus_synd_yield
docs: Permissionless bonus yield for the syndicated liqSOL pool, paid in SOL by the
caller in whole tenths of a SOL (see `inject_bonus_synd_yield_handler`).

accounts.name: donor
docs: Whoever pays: the SOL leaves this account.

accounts.name: reserve_pool
docs: account PDA). Receives the SOL that backs the minted liqSOL.

instructions.name: pay_pending_desyndication
docs: Pay a `DESYNDICATE_LIQ` a frozen outpost stored as a pending payout, once the emergency
stop has cleared. Permissionless; the pending account is closed, so each stored payout
is paid exactly once.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless caller; pays the transaction fee only.

accounts.name: config
docs: Supplies the depot token code -> mint mapping the payout is checked against.

accounts.name: pending_payout
docs: The stored payout. Closed on success, so it can never be paid twice.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: account's rent.

accounts.name: global_state
docs: settlement itself: a typed `Account` would re-serialize its stale pre-payment copy over
that write when the instruction exits.

accounts.name: distribution_state
docs: `global_state`.

instructions.name: report_liq_yield
docs: Permissionless PostLaunch liq-yield report: claims the pool's pending rewards and
reports the amount claimed since the previous report as one global `LIQYield`
attestation; low-priority/margin-gated, and a no-op when the delta is zero.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless cranker / fee payer (unconstrained).

instructions.name: set_frozen
docs: Set or clear the outpost's emergency stop (`GlobalState.frozen`). Signed by the panic
account or the admin. Independent of `set_paused`.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The admin or the configured panic account.

instructions.name: set_panic
docs: Name the emergency-stop (panic) account, which may call `set_frozen` and nothing else.
Admin-only.

accounts.name: global_config
docs: Global config for deposit settings

accounts.name: bucket_token_account
docs: The bucket's associated token account

accounts.name: global_config
docs: Read for the per-transfer syndication maximum (`max_syndication_per_transfer`). Never
written here, so a syndication cannot move its own ceiling.

accounts.name: outpost_account
docs: The user's pre-launch position record. Required (and created on first use) in
PreLaunch, where the pretoken accounting is per-user and lives here.
PostLaunch passes None: a syndicated position becomes OUTPOST PROPERTY the moment
`SyndicateLIQ` is queued and the DEPOT is its ledger of record, so the outpost keeps
no per-user syndication state at all -- and must not pay rent to create an account it
will never read.
`space` is the EXISTING data length whenever the account is already allocated, and only
falls back to `8 + OutpostAccount::INIT_SPACE` for a first-time create. `init_if_needed`
asserts `declared space == actual data_len` on EVERY call (ConstraintSpace otherwise), so
a fixed literal would revert for every staker whose record predates a layout change --
and this branch shrank `OutpostAccount::INIT_SPACE` by 9 bytes (`last_reward_ref` removed).
Shrinking is layout-safe for readers: the retained fields are a byte-identical PREFIX of
the legacy record, so a legacy-sized account deserializes fine (borsh ignores the trailing
bytes) and re-serializes into the same prefix. Identical expression to
`desyndicate_liqsol.rs` / `wire_pretokens/purchase_pretoken.rs`.

accounts.name: pretoken_purchase_history
docs: Legacy pretoken history -- the synd/yield source in PreLaunch.
Optional because PostLaunch retires it (and `close_pretoken_singletons` closes it), so
PostLaunch callers pass None; the handler requires it present in the PreLaunch path.

accounts.name: outbound_message_buffer
docs: OPP outbound buffer the `SyndicateLIQ` is queued on. Zero-copy (`AccountLoader`) so
this PostLaunch hot path appends without the ~9KB borsh round-trip a
`Box<Account<_>>` deserialize would cost.

accounts.name: config
docs: OPP config for the `SyndicateLIQ`: its `chain_code`, and the `token_code` the liqSOL
mint is registered under (`token_addresses_by_code`).

types.name: GlobalConfig
docs: Zero-copy global config PDA

fields.name: panic
docs: Emergency-stop (panic) account. May call `set_frozen` and nothing else: every other
configuration instruction is gated on `admin` alone. Set by the admin with `set_panic`;
the all-zero default means "no panic account configured" and authorizes nobody (see
[`GlobalConfig::is_freeze_authority`]). Occupies the slot that was `_reserved_pubkey[0]`,
so the account layout and `LEN` are unchanged and an existing config reads it as unset.

fields.name: min_user_deposit
docs: Minimum SOL amount a user can deposit

fields.name: min_unstake_request
docs: Minimum SOL amount for an unstake/withdrawal request

fields.name: min_rebalance_stake_delta
docs: Minimum stake delta to trigger a stake rebalance order

fields.name: min_rebalance_unstake_delta
docs: Minimum unstake delta to trigger an unstake rebalance order

fields.name: transient_threshold
docs: DEPRECATED (WNS-33): no longer read. Kept for account layout stability.
Rebalance now counts all transient stake on both sides of the delta equation,
so the per-validator threshold gate was removed.

fields.name: min_late_epoch_slot_gate
docs: Minimum slots that must have elapsed in the epoch before late epoch operations can execute

fields.name: max_syndication_per_transfer
docs: Per-transfer syndication maximum, in the smallest unit of the liqSOL token: the largest
amount one `synd` call may syndicate. Set by the admin with `set_max_syndication`; the
panic account cannot change it. ZERO refuses every syndication, so an outpost that has
not had it set fails closed (see [`GlobalConfig::require_syndication_within_max`]).
Occupies the first of the two former `_reserved_u64` slots, so the account layout and
`LEN` are unchanged and no migration is needed. The slot is provably zero on every live
account: it has one writer in the whole tree, `initialize`, which stores zero, and the
account was allocated zeroed. A pre-upgrade config therefore reads 0 here, which refuses.

fields.name: cooldown_epochs
docs: Epochs a validator must wait in the graveyard before it is booted. This begins after the last recorded state change

fields.name: deposit_fee_multiplier
docs: Multiplier for deposit fee calculation, this would be average "pay rate x number of epochs we expect the stake to warm up"

fields.name: min_vpp_entry
docs: Minimum VPP score required to enter the active validator set, this is a fall back for when the val set is really small

fields.name: min_vpp_exit
docs: VPP score threshold below which a validator is removed from active set, again a fall back

fields.name: tiny_network_threshold
docs: Max validators for "tiny" network band (uses fixed VPP thresholds) as above

fields.name: small_network_threshold
docs: Max validators for "small" network band (uses percentile-based selection)

fields.name: medium_network_threshold
docs: Max validators for "medium" network band (uses percentile-based selection)

fields.name: large_network_entry_rank
docs: Fixed rank threshold to enter active set in large networks (0-indexed)

fields.name: large_network_exit_rank
docs: Fixed rank threshold to exit active set in large networks (0-indexed)

fields.name: small_network_entry_percent
docs: Percentile rank required to enter active set in small networks

fields.name: small_network_exit_percent
docs: Percentile rank below which validators exit in small networks

fields.name: medium_network_entry_percent
docs: Percentile rank required to enter active set in medium networks

fields.name: medium_network_exit_percent
docs: Percentile rank below which validators exit in medium networks

fields.name: feature_flags
docs: Bit 0: DepositsEnabled, Bit 1: WithdrawalsEnabled, Bit 2: ClaimWithdrawalsEnabled,
Bit 3: ProcessStakeOrdersEnabled, Bit 4: ProcessUnstakeOrdersEnabled,
Bit 5: ProcessPayCycleEnabled, Bit 6: RebalancingEnabled, Bits 7-15: Reserved

fields.name: layout_version
docs: Layout version stored in the legacy `deployed_at` slot.

fields.name: yield_index_remainder
docs: Scaled numerator carry, reduced modulo the share supply at each yield update.
Stored in the legacy `refund_delay_seconds` slot so account size is unchanged.

fields.name: paused
docs: Global pause flag - when true, all operations except refunds are disabled

fields.name: total_staked_liqsol
docs: Aggregate liqSOL staked through pretokens (maps to distribution tracked balance)

fields.name: total_purchased_liqsol
docs: Aggregate liqSOL pretoken purchases (part of distribution tracked balance)

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Total shares issued to all users (for share/index yield isolation)

fields.name: protocol_shares
docs: Total shares issued to protocol (for share/index yield isolation).
Retained for layout only: no handler reads it. On a freshly initialised chain it is
zero; on a chain upgraded from v1.6 it is FROZEN at its last pre-upgrade value and is
not a live figure -- the upgrade is a program upgrade plus
`migrate_global_state_liq_fields`, which is a pure realloc, so neither
`initialize_wire_config` nor the `development` reset (the only two writers) runs.

fields.name: current_index
docs: Current share-to-token exchange rate (scaled by INDEX_SCALE = 1e12)
Starts at INDEX_SCALE (1.0) and grows as yield accrues

fields.name: expected_pool_balance
docs: Expected liqSOL pool balance (tracked by protocol operations, not read from on-chain balance).
Retained for layout only: no handler reads it. On a freshly initialised chain it is
zero; on a chain upgraded from v1.6 it is FROZEN at its last pre-upgrade value and is
not a live figure -- the upgrade is a program upgrade plus
`migrate_global_state_liq_fields`, which is a pure realloc, so neither
`initialize_wire_config` nor the `development` reset (the only two writers) runs. A
reader who takes it for a live pool figure will be reading a stale one that diverges
further on every later syndication and exit.

fields.name: yield_accumulated_liqsol
docs: Accumulated liqSOL yield available for protocol pretoken purchases

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Bytes of the retired Bonded Actor Registry role config (`role_principals` then
`role_warmup_duration`). Kept so `wire_state` and `bump` stay at their deployed
offsets. Nothing reads them; `admin_clear_bond_config` zeroed them before the
registry was removed, so confirm they are still zero before carving a field out.

fields.name: liq_sequence
docs: Per-outpost monotonic sequence shared by `SyndicateLIQ` and `LIQYield`. The depot
orders and dedupes the two streams on this one counter, so it must never be reset
while the outpost is live.

fields.name: liq_yield_reported
docs: Watermark on `yield_accumulated_liqsol`: the total pool yield already reported to the
depot as `LIQYield`. `report_liq_yield` emits the delta and then advances this to
`yield_accumulated_liqsol`. Reset to 0 alongside `yield_accumulated_liqsol` wherever
that counter is consumed (`init_liqsol_reserve`), so the delta can never go negative.

fields.name: frozen
docs: Emergency-stop flag, set and cleared by `set_frozen` (the panic account or the admin).
While set, `synd`, `desynd` and `report_liq_yield` are refused, and a depot-ordered
`DESYNDICATE_LIQ` is stored as a `PendingPayout` instead of being paid; the
permissionless `pay_pending_desyndication` pays it once the flag clears. Independent
of `paused`, which keeps its own meaning. APPENDED after `liq_yield_reported`: the
retired `_reserved` bytes are not guaranteed zero on a live chain, so no field is carved
out of them. An existing account is grown by `migrate_global_state_liq_fields`, whose
zeroed tail reads as `false`.

types.name: PendingPayout
docs: One deferred `DESYNDICATE_LIQ`, keyed by the depot's request id.
Carries everything the payout needs (`user`, `token_code`, `amount`) and the depot's
`request_id` a reconciler matches it back to the depot's `desyndlog` by. The outpost's
syndicated totals are NOT touched when it is stored: the payout is applied -- and counted --
only when `pay_pending_desyndication` pays it.

fields.name: request_id
docs: The depot's `DesyndicateLIQ.request_id` (never 0; 0 means "no id" and cannot key a PDA).

fields.name: user
docs: The holder the depot ordered paid; their Token-2022 liqSOL ATA is the destination.

fields.name: token_code
docs: The depot token code the payout is denominated in, checked against the pool's liqSOL
mint again at payment time.

fields.name: amount
docs: liqSOL base units to pay.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who funded this account's rent (the settlement crank's caller); refunded on payment.

fields.name: reason
docs: Why the payout was deferred.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: PendingPayoutReason
docs: Why a `DESYNDICATE_LIQ` was stored instead of paid inline.

fields.name: pool_balance
docs: The pool ATA's liqSOL balance when the payout arrived, before anything moved.

fields.name: depot_outstanding
docs: The depot's outstanding shadow after its burn (`DesyndicateLIQ.total_syndicated`).
